recommendations.title: Duplex consensus step crashes after adjacency grouping
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md groups with --strategy=adjacency and then says 'or for duplex' CallDuplexConsensusReads on the same grouped.bam; on the real UMI BAM this throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException (exit 1). With --strategy=paired the same call emits 4042 duplex reads.
recommendations.root_cause: Duplex calling needs MI tags with /A /B strand suffixes, which only the paired strategy writes; the Skill shares one grouping command between two consensus paths.
recommendations.fix: Show two separate branches: adjacency -> CallMolecularConsensusReads, and 'GroupReadsByUmi --strategy=paired' -> CallDuplexConsensusReads. State the input prerequisites for GroupReadsByUmi (mate info via SetMateInformation on queryname-grouped input, or samtools fixmate -m output).

recommendations.title: umi_tools dedup example omits sort/index and --paired
recommendations.problem: The umi_tools command fails on an unsorted/unindexed BAM ('fetch called on bamfile without index') and, on a sorted paired-end BAM without --paired, silently outputs 2805 records instead of 5689 (mates dropped). Neither requirement is stated.
recommendations.root_cause: Example was written for single-end 10x BAMs and generalised to bulk/ctDNA capture BAMs without the prerequisites.
recommendations.fix: Add: input must be coordinate-sorted and indexed; add --paired for paired-end libraries; note that --per-cell with absent CB/UB tags gives an empty BAM with exit 0, so check the tags first.

recommendations.title: Optimized pipeline fails from a clean directory and hides it
recommendations.problem: 'samtools collate ... tmpdir/collate' fails when tmpdir/ does not exist; the pipe still exits 0 and writes an empty 501-byte marked.bam. The shipped markdup_pipeline.sh has the same no-pipefail structure and only exits non-zero because the later index step fails.
recommendations.root_cause: No mkdir for the temp dir and no 'set -o pipefail' or output check in either the SKILL.md pipeline or the shipped example.
recommendations.fix: Add 'mkdir -p tmpdir' (or use mktemp -d) before the pipeline, 'set -o pipefail' in the example, and an assertion that the flagstat 'duplicates' line and record count are sane after marking.

recommendations.title: Common Errors table and Critical pitfall do not match samtools 1.24
recommendations.problem: Real messages are 'no ms score tag', 'Coordinate sorted, require grouped/sorted by queryname' and 'queryname sorted, must be sorted by coordinate'; the table lists 'mate not found', 'no MC tag' (for a missing -m) and 'not coordinate sorted'. The pitfall says missing tags silently mark almost nothing, but 1.24 exits 1 with an error.
recommendations.root_cause: Error strings were paraphrased or taken from older versions.
recommendations.fix: Replace the table with the verbatim messages and delete or version-qualify the 'silently marks almost nothing' claim.

recommendations.title: No guidance on -c (re-marking) or read groups for Picard
recommendations.problem: Re-running markdup on an already-flagged BAM without -c retained old flags (111 vs 101 from -c and Picard on the 1000G slice). Picard MarkDuplicates throws a NullPointerException on a BAM without @RG, which is what the Skill's own bwa-mem2 example produces (no -R).
recommendations.root_cause: Options in samtools markdup --help (-c, -S) and Picard's RG requirement are not covered.
recommendations.fix: Add one line on -c for pre-marked or merged BAMs, add -R '@RG...' to the bwa-mem2 example, and note Picard needs @RG.

recommendations.title: usage-guide repeats SKILL.md and contradicts it
recommendations.problem: usage-guide says '-d 2500 for NovaSeq, NextSeq' and 'HiSeq -d 100' while SKILL.md gives NextSeq 500/550 and MiSeq 100, HiSeq 3000/4000/X 2500; duplicate-rate denominators differ (all records vs -F 256 vs primary only); the example script omits -d; the 'markdup -@ 8 fixes high memory' tip is unsupported (maxRSS rose 7.4 -> 13.8 MB).
recommendations.root_cause: Two documents restate the same facts and drifted apart.
recommendations.fix: Keep the platform/-d matrix, workflow and rate formula only in SKILL.md, point usage-guide at it, and delete the memory tip or replace it with -T on a large scratch disk.

recommendations.title: Workflow steps do not gate on assay
recommendations.problem: The decision table says NO for bulk RNA-seq, amplicon and UMI assays (verified: 1980/2000 amplicon reads and 38% of reads at the top RNA locus get flagged), but the usage-guide 'What the Agent Will Do' and the shipped example run markdup on any BAM.
recommendations.root_cause: Assay check lives only in a table.
recommendations.fix: Add step 0 to the workflow and to the example: confirm assay (RNA-seq, amplicon, UMI, scRNA), stop and hand off to the named tool if it is on the NO list.
